name: BigCommerce
needs: an app or a higher plan

invoices.text: Printable invoices built in; credit notes through an app

withdrawal.text: Not offered natively yet, according to BigCommerce's blog post of 1 July 2026

vat.text: Tax zones set by hand, or VAT worked out by an app

subscriptions.text: Needs an app or a specific payment gateway, says BigCommerce

b2b.text: B2B Edition, included with new Performance stores; price lists on Performance

stores.text: {{check}} Built in, as a paid add-on per storefront, up to 3, 5 or 8 by plan

backinstock.text: Needs an app, says BigCommerce's help centre

preorders.text: {{check}} Built in, with a release date

email.text: Abandoned-cart emails from the Growth plan; campaigns through an app

ai.text: {{check}} Companion, included; it changes nothing without your approval

mobilepay.text: {{check}} Through Adyen or Stripe, for Danish and Finnish billing addresses

carriers.text: Through an app, such as one for PostNord labels

strengths.text: You want your own headless front end: Catalyst is BigCommerce's open-source storefront on Next.js and React
You run several brands or regions as storefronts from one back end
You need deep B2B on its top plan: company hierarchies, quotes, purchase orders and net terms
You want its free migration app for a large catalogue
You need a long list of security certifications, from PCI DSS Level 1 to ISO and SOC

title: Kaizena Flow compared with BigCommerce

seo.title: Kaizena Flow vs BigCommerce: compared for EU shops
seo.description: How Kaizena Flow compares with BigCommerce for EU shops: the EU's rules, more ways to sell, AI, and what needs an app, checked on BigCommerce's own pages.

heroRest: The legal side of EU selling, more ways to sell and an AI that runs the shop come with Flow. Here is how it compares with BigCommerce, line by line.

faq.q: Can I move my BigCommerce shop to Flow?
faq.bold: Yes, and we do it for you.
faq.rest: As part of getting you started, we move your shop free of charge. You can also copy pages from your live site and check your old links yourself.

faq.q: Do I need apps to get what the Flow column shows?
faq.rest: Everything in the Flow column is part of Flow. Owning several stores starts on the Grow plan.
Your store's database and servers are in Dublin, Ireland.

faq.q: Is it safe to let the AI work on its own?
faq.bold: You decide how much it does.
faq.rest: Refunds, emails to your whole list, changes to your staff and your domain always wait for your yes, and every change it makes is in the activity log.
